messages:
ravi: heads-up: deploybot bubbled a compatibility warning during the night staged unpin in us-west for quant-q5 on runtime 3.4. Can we triage?

deploybot: [ALERT] CompatibilityAlert runtime=3.4 region=us-west model=quant-q5 code=KERNELOPS_MISMATCH severity=warning

tara: which nodes and any stack trace?

ravi: 2 a100 hosts. excerpt: 
```
ERROR kernel_dispatch: unsupported op fused_gemm_bias_relu for int8_path
file: runtime/op_dispatch.cc:214
ctx: quant path built with prune-aggressive=true
```

kevin: that fused op was part of the perf consolidation in 3.4. Looks like the quant bundle prune removed the compatibility shim. We should avoid rolling back the entire runtime if possible.

tara: agree. Proposal: soft-pin quant-q5 to runtime=3.3 in us-west for 60m, kevin prepares a 3.4.hotfix that reintroduces the shim. Notify support and add a short release note.

ravi: can someone run the pin? I'll also open a quick INF ticket.

deploybot: command: `deploybot pin runtime=3.3 model=quant-q5 region=us-west ttl=3600 reason="missing-fused-op-shim"`

ravi: running it now.

deploybot: OK: pin applied to 2 hosts in us-west. Staged-unpin paused. Ticket INF-4550 created.

kevin: I'll cut a debug hotfix (3.4.1-hotfix-shim) with the shim re-added and a binary flag to disable aggressive prune for quant bundles. ETA ~35m.

ops-oncall: taking monitoring handoff. I'll alert on >4% errors or +150ms p50. If metrics degrade we escalate to rollback to 3.2 across canary.

support-lead: pinged CS leads and support rotation for possible customer hits.

kevin: uploaded hotfix hash 3.4.1-shim-20260324 sha256=def456... starting 1-host canary.

tara: canary smoke: latency nominal, no generation errors in 20m.

ops-oncall: metrics look stable for 25m. No alerts.

ravi: plan: if hotfix holds for 45m, unpin and resume staged-unpin. Postmortem action: add a kernel-include smoke in CI for quant builds to catch prune regressions.

kevin: agreed. I'll push patch and follow-up PR to the build pipeline to test kernel shims.

ravi: unpinning in 15m if no regressions.

deploybot: reminder: when unpinning use `deploybot unpin runtime=3.4 model=quant-q5 region=us-west note="hotfix validated"`

support-lead: CS notified. Will send a brief note to affected customers if we observe any uptick.

tara: thanks everyone. updating release notes and INF-4550. :thumbsup:
